_note: Factory hooks only. This file is shared by every persona on the machine, so nothing domain-specific belongs here — a persona's own hooks go in <memoryDir>/hooks.json, where it writes and owns them. What stays here is the pair that teaches a persona how to edit itself, which is the one thing every persona needs.
